title: Flimsy
text: Flimsy. This is just a so-so press. The metal top does not fit snug in the glass insert, the metal band on the bottom is ultra thin and bent upon 1st use. Because this is a 3 piece unit, the entire thing needs to be disassembled after every use or water will accumulate and get stuck between the glass and the base. I wouldn’t order this again.
